verification.scope: Original bytes of macro and logical line verified. One paired LATER exclusion. No executable behavior change; no new build or release.

decision: R2527 partially restored: original line 16 OPTIONMASK has no expansion in this translation unit. Remaining private shutdown state belongs to native USER. NotifyLogon dereferences kernel windowstations; InitiateShutdown uses ETHREAD and privilege checks; EndShutdown and client shutdown access private desktop/window state. WU32ExitWindows uses public ExitWindows. Registration uses locked currentProcess and an independently retained, access-checked event via wow_task_reference_event.
